description: Quick Export the whole document, or chosen layers, groups or artboards, as PNG, JPG or GIF into a folder in one step (File > Export > Quick Export As; Layers panel > Quick Export As). Files are named after the document or each layer

includeMetadata.description: Include copyright and contact metadata. Default false

layers.description: Export these layers, groups or artboards, each to its own file. Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Default: the whole document

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: quick_export
title: Quick Export
